column4: Will you open the gate before dawn?
No. I will wait until the guards return.
Carry the signal lantern to the night watch.
Tell the night watch to keep the signal lantern lit.

The courier left three sealed letters at the eastern gate before sunset. Keep them in the locked chest until the captain returns, and do not give any letter to a visitor. If the captain is delayed, ask the guard to send a message at dawn.
